note: Shown by HyperFramesFeatures.ps1. Paths may use ~ (home) and %DESKTOP%.

features.name: Studio (edit and preview a project)
bullets: Double-click 'HyperFrames' on the Desktop: it opens on a list of your projects
Search or click a project to open it in Studio, in the same window
Alt+Left in Studio goes back to the list; scrub, play and check scenes before rendering
features.ask: double-click 'HyperFrames' on the Desktop

features.name: Render to MP4
bullets: Turns a project into a finished video file
Same result as the Studio preview, frame for frame
features.ask: render this project to MP4

features.name: Auto captions
bullets: Transcribes the voice with Whisper on your PC
Adds word-timed captions you can restyle
features.ask: add captions to this video

features.name: Text-based editing (transcript-cut)
bullets: Edit the video by deleting words from its transcript
Removes silences and 'um's automatically
features.ask: cut the silences and ums from this clip

features.name: Catalog blocks
bullets: Ready-made scenes: charts, titles, lower thirds, transitions
Added straight into a project
features.ask: add a data-chart block to my project

features.name: Voice cleanup
bullets: Removes noise, hum and echo with DeepFilterNet on your PC
Paid option: ElevenLabs Voice Isolator, only if you set its key
features.ask: clean up this voice recording

features.name: Dialogue leveling
bullets: Evens out loud and quiet phrases
Finishes at a standard loudness
features.ask: even out the voice levels

features.name: Beats and snap to beat
bullets: Finds the beats even in soft music
Moves scene changes onto the beat, keeping a backup
features.ask: snap the scene changes to the beat

features.name: Auto-ducking
bullets: Lowers the music while someone speaks
Raises it again in the gaps
features.ask: duck the music under the voice

features.name: Smart reframe to vertical
bullets: Turns wide footage into 9:16 following the speaker
Holds still for small moves and through camera pans
features.ask: make this clip vertical, following the speaker

features.name: Stabilise
bullets: Steadies shaky footage
Zooms in slightly to hide the moving edges
features.ask: steady this clip

features.name: Denoise grain
bullets: Cleans up grainy or low-light footage
features.ask: clean up the grain

features.name: Smooth slow motion
bullets: Invents in-between frames with RIFE on your GPU
Or smooths a clip to 60 fps
features.ask: make this 4x slow motion

features.name: Upscale
bullets: Enlarges footage 2x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN on your GPU
Sharper than plain enlarging, but slower
features.ask: upscale this to 2x

features.name: Auto-correct colour
bullets: Fixes colour casts and exposure
Keeps a little of the clip's natural warmth
features.ask: fix the colour of this clip

features.name: Match shots and LUTs
bullets: Makes clip B look like clip A
Applies any .cube LUT
features.ask: match clip B to clip A

features.name: Audio-reactive bars and pulse
bullets: Bars or a logo that move with the music or voice
features.ask: add bars that move with the music

features.name: Picture-in-picture
bullets: Puts a second clip in a corner, rounded or circular
Slides in and out
features.ask: put the webcam clip in the top-right corner

features.name: Lottie animations and loops
bullets: Plays any LottieFiles animation once, looping or ping-pong
Bob, pulse and loop motion that keeps the timeline length right
features.ask: add this LottieFiles animation, looping

features.name: Record your voice sample
bullets: Finds your Rode mic and tests the level first
Saves to the recordings folder
features.ask: double-click 'Record voice sample' on the Desktop

features.name: Your cloned voice
bullets: Voices any script in your own voice with F5-TTS, keeping your accent
Pace set to 166 words a minute; ask to change it
features.ask: voice this script in my voice

features.name: Footage search
bullets: Indexes a folder of clips
Finds moments by what's said or what's on screen
Cuts the moment out as a clip
features.ask: find the clip where I say pullback

features.name: Platform export
bullets: YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Reels and X versions in one go
Right sizes and loudness for each
features.ask: export for Shorts, TikTok, Reels, YouTube and X

features.name: Publishing with approval
bullets: Drafts posts in Postiz (X) and Buffer (TikTok, Instagram)
Nothing is scheduled until you say yes to that post
features.ask: draft posts for this video on X, TikTok and Instagram

features.name: Highlights from a long video (AutoClip)
bullets: Finds and scores the best moments in a long talk or stream
Clips land next to the video, best first, with their transcript
Uses your free Gemini key; about 3 minutes for a 5-minute video
features.ask: find the best highlights in this long video

features.name: Check a finished render
bullets: Re-listens to the render and lists extra, missing or changed words against the script
Checks audio and video lengths match
Finds 1-2 frame flickers
features.ask: check this render against the script

features.name: Shorts Generator
bullets: Finds the best moment in a long video
Cuts it to a vertical short with the speaker centred
features.ask: make a short from this long video

features.name: Kinocut
bullets: Quick trims, merges, speed changes and text overlays
Quality check before you publish
features.ask: use kinocut to trim this clip to 0:10-0:40

features.name: Vox-style explainer
bullets: Turns a document into a Vox-style explainer video
features.ask: make a Vox-style explainer from this document

features.name: Designed captions
bullets: Cinematic and 3D camera captions
Styled to match the video
features.ask: add cinematic captions to this video

features.name: Motion reel
bullets: Fast-cut motion graphics reels
features.ask: make a motion reel for my channel

features.name: Sprite avatar
bullets: Animated cartoon presenter from character artwork
Not a realistic talking head
features.ask: add a sprite avatar presenter

features.name: Ghost editor
bullets: Edits talking-head footage with B-roll
Needs a Gemini key; built for Macs, may stop on Windows
features.ask: ghost-edit this talking-head clip

features.name: Herk Edit Kit
bullets: A full edit kit with its own HyperFrames version
Start Claude in its folder to use it
features.ask: start Claude in addons\herk-edit-kit

features.name: Web, YouTube and Reddit research (Agent Reach)
bullets: Reads YouTube video details and subtitles
Searches the web and reads pages; public Reddit/X search
Read-only, no logins; free search has an hourly limit
features.ask: research what people are saying about pullback trading

features.name: Outlier posts and trends (ScrapeCreators)
bullets: Finds posts that beat a creator's usual numbers, and why
Trending topics, hashtags, sounds and formats in your niche
Needs your paid SCRAPECREATORS_API_KEY
features.ask: find outlier trading videos on TikTok this month

features.name: Comments and competitors (ScrapeCreators)
bullets: Mines comments for questions, objections and audience language
Compares competitors' content pillars and gaps
Tears down a creator or their ads
features.ask: mine the comments on this video for questions people ask
